title: Zesty Nutty Italian Banana Pinsa
description: A nutty and chewy Italian dish featuring fried ripe bananas, perfect for a cozy dessert or snack. This pinsa combines the sweetness of bananas with the crunch of nuts.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, sugar, and yeast.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and olive oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a 1/4 inch thick circle.
Arrange the banana slices on one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the chopped hazelnuts over the bananas.
Fold the other half of the dough over the bananas and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pinsa with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the pinsa for 20 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
